rows.note: This is the standard all-purpose noun for a bouquet of cut flowers.

example.english: I specially ordered a bouquet for my mum.
example.traditional: 我特登訂咗一份花束畀阿媽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 deng6 zo2 jat1 fan6 faa1 cuk1 bei2 aa3 maa1

rows.note: Use this pattern for a decoratively arranged bunch of things such as balloons rather than for the established flower term 花束.

example.english: That bouquet of balloons at the entrance really stands out.
example.traditional: 門口嗰一束氣球幾搶眼呀。
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 go2 jat1 cuk1 hei3 kau4 gei2 coeng2 ngaan5 aa3

rows.note: Use this for the characteristic aroma of a wine when discussing its smell or tasting qualities.

example.english: The bouquet of this red wine is very strong, with fruity notes.
example.traditional: 呢支紅酒嘅酒香好濃，飲落有果香。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 hung4 zau2 ge3 zau2 hoeng1 hou2 nung4 jam2 lok6 jau5 gwo2 hoeng1
